cohort: 177 pregnant women presenting for delivery to a tertiary care hospital in Faridpur, Bangladesh, and their newborns
finding: High rates of colonization with ESBL-PB/CRB were found among mothers and newborns, with pre-delivery colonization linked to prior healthcare exposure and post-delivery colonization associated with C-section.
mod_finding: Maternal post-delivery and newborn colonization with ESBL-PB/CRB were associated with C-section.
